items.what: The setting-variable name format "TweaksForever_" .. key is built in Settings.lua:37 (registration) and Settings.lua:67, then restated by hand at every read site: as a full literal in Errors.lua:75, MacroNames.lua:44, Reagents.lua:283, Gear.lua:717-719, Spellbook.lua:648, Frames.lua:851, Fishing.lua:211, Sections.lua:230, and as "TweaksForever_" .. CONST in Tooltips.lua:432-433 and QuestProgress.lua:365. The persisted part is feature.key in TweaksForeverDB (unchanged by a helper); the prefix is an in-process registry name, so centralising it changes no saved data.
items.reason: Add ns.OnSettingChanged(key, fn) in Core that asserts the key like ns.Active and builds TweaksForever_ once, then route the 14 SetOnValueChangedCallback sites (Errors, MacroNames, Sections, Reagents, Gear x3, Spellbook, Frames, Fishing, Tooltips x2, QuestProgress) through it? items.quote:
local chunk = type(source) == "string" and loadstring(source)
	if not chunk then
		return nil
	end
	setfenv(chunk, {})
	local ok, value = pcall(chunk)
	return ok and type(value) == "table" and value or nil
items.what: BUG: ZoneDB source parse/evaluation failures become nil; Attach substitutes empty overrides or silently abandons initialization.
items.why: Table discards both loadstring and pcall errors. Attach replaces an unreadable areaIdToUiMapIdOverride with {}, so MapOf falls back to base maps even where an override should exclude or remap an area. Reproduced without writing fixtures: appended an in-memory probe to tests/questgivers_spec.lua, replaced only the support source with 'return { [12] = 0', then observed Attach() and needs.check() both true and Resolve('Di', 0, 1490, 500) returning NPC 5; the intact fixture returns nil because area 12 is excluded. With areaIdToUiMapId changed to 'return {', Attach() returned false and the initializer installed no tooltip callback, but needs.check() stayed true. The needs check only validates ns.QuestieDB(), so Core.RefreshConflicts/Settings cannot expose these failures. Repository-wide searches found no other caller that surfaces the parse error or attachment failure. Preserve the sandbox and third-party validation, but distinguish absent optional data from failed parsing and report the failure or reflect it in feature availability. These were synthetic fault probes, not observations of an installed QuestieDB failure.

items.quote: def db2(name, refresh=False, offline=False):
items.what: The wago.tools DB2 fetch-and-cache (pinned BUILD, CACHE path, --offline/--refresh, User-Agent, HTML-response check, cache write) is written five times: gen_dungeons.py:78-94, gen_zonelevels.py:96-112 (byte-identical to gen_dungeons), gen_classspells.py:62-78, gen_camp.py:33-54, gen_overlays.py:29-67; the pin `BUILD = "1.60.1.70009"` is restated in all five (refresh-data.yml:38 seds it into each file). Canonical home: one shared tools module holding BUILD, CACHE and the download/cache step with gen_overlays' atomic write, each generator keeping only its own row parsing.
items.why: Differences: (1) cache write is atomic in gen_overlays (write_atomic) and in gen_classspells' classicdb(), but a plain path.write_bytes in the other four copies: accidental drift, since an interrupted write leaves a truncated CSV that the next run reads from cache, and zonelevels/dungeons/classspells only check that a first row with an ID column exists, so a truncated table passes. (2) timeouts 60 / 300 / 600: drift. (3) validation: overlays checks every schema column, int-parses and rejects duplicate IDs; the rest check only ID: drift. (4) return shape (int-parsed dict, raw row list, rows grouped by a key) and gen_classspells' build parameter: intentional, per generator. tools/README.md says each generator has 'Same cache and flags as gen_overlays.py', so the docs already treat it as one mechanism. Generators run as `python3 tools/gen_x.py` while the *_test.py files import `tools.gen_*`, so the shared module needs phrases.py's `from tools.x import` pattern (and `-m` in refresh-data.yml:40) or equivalent.
items.reason: Move the five wago.tools db2 fetch-and-cache copies and BUILD into one tools module? Generators run as scripts (tools/ on sys.path) but specs import them as tools.gen_*, so it needs an import-mode choice, the refresh-data.yml sed pointed at one file, and a byte-identical regeneration at the pinned build.
